seq.description: Position of the line in the plan's history, one above the last; a client resumes reading after a seq.

event.description: entered or left a state; called or returned from a sub-workflow (a phase, an axis variant, a remediation unit, git.commit_and_push, a chat, a decision); instance: a new instance version took force.

node.description: The fully qualified state id (entered, left), the sub-workflow id (called, returned), or plan for an instance line.

call_path.description: The subworkflow_id of every frame of the call stack at the line, bottom to top; for a called line without the new frame, for a returned line without the popped one.

phase.description: The plan's phase value at the line (store-schemas/03, Phases as Sub-Workflows); null before the first phase is called.

outcome.description: left: the outcome the state settled, by which the transition was chosen; returned: the sub-workflow's exit outcome; null otherwise.

instance_version.description: The plan instance version in force at the line; for an instance line the version that took force.
